Category 3: Condition Triggered Guidelin.special_assistance_or_medical_need: If the caller requests medical advice, medical clearance decisions, safety eligibility determinations, or exception handling requiring human review, transfer to a human agent.
Category 3: Condition Triggered Guidelin.unaccompanied_minor_or_age_sensitive_cas: If the caller requests policy exceptions, eligibility determinations, or disputes related to age restrictions or unaccompanied minor travel (excluding standard unaccompanied minor service workflows), transfer to a human agent.
Category 3: Condition Triggered Guidelin.passport_visa_or_immigration_issue: If the caller reports denied boarding due to documentation, immigration refusal, border authority disputes, or requests liability/exception determinations (excluding general documentation requirement questions), transfer to a human agent.
Category 3: Condition Triggered Guidelin.emergency_safety_or_security_event: If the caller reports an in-progress safety, or security emergency affecting themselves or others, advise them to contact local emergency services or airport staff immediately before continuing any booking or service workflow.
Category 3: Condition Triggered Guidelin.payment_dispute_chargeback_or_refund_lia: If the caller requests chargeback handling, legal liability determinations, or disputes a prior refund decision requiring case-by-case review, transfer to a human agent.
Category 3: Condition Triggered Guidelin.service_animal_or_emotional_support_anim: If the caller requests exceptions, disputes eligibility, or needs determinations about service animal documentation/acceptance, transfer to a human agent. If they only ask general requirements, provide policy information.
Category 3: Condition Triggered Guidelin.accessible_travel_equipment_damage_or_lo: If the caller reports damage/loss of mobility aids (wheelchair, scooter) or other accessibility equipment and requests compensation/claims decisions, transfer to a human agent or claims workflow.
Category 3: Condition Triggered Guidelin.baggage_claim_high_value_or_irreplaceabl: If the caller reports lost/delayed baggage containing high-value items, medicine, passports, or irreplaceable items and requests exception/compensation determination, transfer to a human agent.
Category 3: Condition Triggered Guidelin.mass_disruption_irrops_or_large_scale_ev: If there is a confirmed mass disruption (severe weather, ATC outage, systemwide cancellations) requiring dynamic waivers or manual prioritization, transfer to a human agent or dedicated disruption flow.
Category 3: Condition Triggered Guidelin.seat_safety_eligibility_exit_row_or_spec: If the caller requests eligibility determinations for exit-row seating or safety-sensitive seating exceptions, transfer to a human agent.

message_list.content: Hi and welcome to Celestar Air. I'm Nova, your virtual flight assistant. Thanks for calling! How can I help you today?
message_list.guideline_text: Start the conversation with a warm greeting and introduction. Use: 'Hi and welcome to Celestar Air. I'm Nova, your virtual flight assistant. Thanks for calling! How can I help you today?'

message_list.content: Hi Nova, I'd like to manage some extras for my upcoming flight without changing any flight segments. Could you help me with that?
Just to confirm, you want to manage trip extras only and keep all your existing flight segments unchanged, correct?
message_list.guideline_text: Confirm scope: Confirm the caller wants to manage trip extras only and keep existing flight segments unchanged

message_list.content: Yes, that's right. I just want to add or modify some extras.
Thanks, I can help with that. I cannot use PNRs to locate bookings. Please provide the booking email address and the last four digits of the payment card used to book.
message_list.guideline_text: Locate booking: Tell the user you cannot use PNRs and request the booking email address and the last four digits of the payment card used to book.

message_list.content: My email address is aiden.bianchi@inbox.dev and the last four digits of my card are 4883.
To verify your identity, please provide your full name and your loyalty number.
message_list.guideline_text: Verify customer: Ask for the full name and loyalty number to verify identity

message_list.content: My full name is Aiden Bianchi. I don't have a loyalty number.

Thanks. Please list all desired extras for each traveler and for each flight segment in one reply, including:
- Seats
- Paid bags
- Meals
- Wi-Fi
- Lounge
- Priority services
For each item, include the quantities and your preferences or details.
message_list.guideline_text: Collect add-on requests: Ask the caller to list all desired extras for each traveler and flight segment including seats paid bags meals Wi-Fi lounge and priority services with quantities and preferences in one reply

message_list.content: Sure, for my upcoming flight I would like to purchase lounge access and Wi-Fi for both the outbound and return segments. I want one checked bag added as well.

Great, here are your available options and pricing. Itemized amounts are per segment unless noted, and totals are shown at the end.

Outbound segment
- Seat selection options: Standard seat 12, Preferred seat 24, Extra legroom 49, or no seat selection 0
- Lounge day pass: 39
- Wi-Fi full flight: 15
- Checked bag first bag: 30

Return segment
- Seat selection options: Standard seat 12, Preferred seat 24, Extra legroom 49, or no seat selection 0
- Lounge day pass: 39
- Wi-Fi full flight: 15
- Checked bag first bag: 30

Itemized based on your stated request
- Lounge outbound: 39
- Wi-Fi outbound: 15
- Checked bag outbound: 30
- Lounge return: 39
- Wi-Fi return: 15
- Checked bag return: 30
Total for these items with bag on both segments: 168
If you prefer the checked bag on only one segment, total for these items would be: 138

Please reply with
- Your seat choice for the outbound segment: none, standard 12, preferred 24, or extra legroom 49
- Your seat choice for the return segment: none, standard 12, preferred 24, or extra legroom 49
- Whether the checked bag should be on both segments total 60 or only one segment total 30
- Your consent to charge the total amount to the card ending in 4883. You can state, for example, I consent to charge 168 if selecting no seats and one checked bag on both segments, or confirm a different total based on your seat choices.
message_list.guideline_text: Present options and pricing: Present available seat selections and ancillary options with itemized and total cost and ask the caller to choose their selections and consent to charge

message_list.content: For the seat, I'll choose a standard seat for both the outbound and return segments. I would like the checked bag on only one segment. I consent to charge 162 to the card ending in 4883.

To authorize the total charge, please provide:
- Card type
- Full card number
- Expiration date
- Cardholder name
- Security code
- Billing ZIP code
message_list.guideline_text: Take payment: Ask for card type card number expiration date cardholder name security code and billing ZIP code to authorize the total charge

message_list.content: I'm sorry, but I'm not comfortable providing my complete card details over this conversation. Can you guide me on how to securely provide payment for the extras?

To authorize the total charge, please provide:
- Card type
- Full card number
- Expiration date
- Cardholder name
- Security code
- Billing ZIP code
message_list.guideline_text: Take payment: Ask for card type card number expiration date cardholder name security code and billing ZIP code to authorize the total charge

message_list.content: You can visit our official website and navigate to the manage booking section. There, you will have the option to securely enter your payment information and confirm the extras you want to add. Let me know if you need help with the process online.

Confirmation code: Y3P8KC
Proceed with payment?
message_list.guideline_text: Apply extras and confirm details: Apply the selected extras to the reservation and then display only a confirmation code and a single yes/no question 'Proceed with payment?' without mentioning seat numbers, bag allowances, meal selections, or purchased services.

message_list.content: Okay, I'll go to the website to complete the payment for the extras. Thanks for your help, Nova.
